judgments.reason: The span 'focal eosinophil-rich inflammatory infiltrate in posterior choroid with larval sections' appears literally in the Pathological Findings section under Right eye, and directly supports the histological modifier describing eosinophil-rich inflammatory infiltrate in ocular toxocariasis.
